assumptions: The normalized time step h lies between zero and one.
The perturbation magnitude epsilon is nonnegative.

conditions.L: The identical fixed statement and P18 shared files are present; the frozen NumStability library is also present.

formal_statement.lean_header: theorem p18_t3_smooth_nonsmooth_method_error_bounds {n : Nat} (h epsilon : Real) (scheme perturbation : Fin n -> Real) (hh0 : 0 <= h) (hh1 : h <= 1) (hepsilon : 0 <= epsilon) : smooth_exact_bound and nonsmooth_exact_bound and smooth_envelope <= nonsmooth_envelope
formal_statement.plain_language: Method 4s3pC's smooth third-order precision error and nonsmooth second-order precision error satisfy exact Euclidean envelopes, and the smooth envelope is smaller on a normalized small time step.

informal_proof: Apply the vector triangle and homogeneity inequalities to both error representatives. Normalize absolute values using h and epsilon nonnegativity. Since zero is at most h and h is at most one, h cubed is at most h squared; multiply this inequality by the nonnegative perturbation coefficient norm to compare the envelopes.
informal_statement: Exact finite-vector bounds for the smooth and nonsmooth Method 4s3pC error regimes, plus their small-step ordering.
